evidence.quote: Intimate, late-licensed, Funktion One equipped, East London venue.
packs serious energy into its intimate 300-capacity space

findings.value: Challenge 25: ID required and scanned on entry

evidence.quote: All customers are required to present original ID on entry.

findings.value: Card only at the bar. Cash is still taken at the door for entry. Cloakroom items are paid for by card.

evidence.quote: Basing House is card payment only at the bar. You will however still be able to pay cash on the door to gain entry.
Stowed items are payable by card.

findings.value: The venue's own FAQ gives the nearest stations and bus routes and says there is no private parking. It says nothing about step-free access, toilets or a hearing loop.

not_found: accessibility.step_free (no access statement on the home, about, FAQ, contact or door policy pages; /access/ and /accessibility/ return 404)
AccessAble or Euan's Guide entry (AccessAble venue URL guess returned its home page; web search budget used up in this run)
notes: Two age statements conflict in the venue's own pages: the door policy says Challenge 25, and a newer FAQ page (/new-faq/, not linked from the menu) says events are strictly 18+. Editor to check which is current before setting age_policy. Website is the venue's own site as cited. Basing House's door policy also says it does not admit large male or predominately male parties; that is an entry rule for the editor to weigh, not a profile fact here.
